title: Model health gets a dashboard
summary:
A model-health dashboard joined the community projects, while Flux stopped trading image quality for concurrency.

Model Monitor was added for image and text models, with health states, sortable metrics, sparklines, recent errors, and five-minute views of request counts, success rates, and P50/P95 latency. It refreshes every 15 seconds.

Flux generation now uses four steps for every request instead of cutting steps as concurrency rises, keeping output quality consistent when traffic picks up.

Project listings now include gpt4free and its Python and JavaScript SDKs. The chat-project listing points to G4F Chat UI and notes its image and video generation capabilities.

highlights.title: Watch model health
highlights.text: Explore image and text model health, request trends, success rates, latency, and recent errors in Model Monitor. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
